SubmitPhoneFeedback.description:
Submit real live-call outcomes; accepted feedback changes Trestle models.

Use the Response-ID of a prior lookup when available. Never submit synthetic
outcomes or use this write as a connection test.

response_id.description: The value of the `Response-ID` header (format `T_<uuid>`) returned by the prior Trestle API call this feedback is about. Returned by Address Validation, Reverse Address, Phone Validation, Real Contact 1.1 and 2.0, and Decision Signals. Smart CNAM, Caller Identification, and Reverse Phone do not return it. Optional, but send it whenever you have it so the feedback is linked to that lookup. Example `T_b5d031b8-e8a3-4eef-8fa8-d87d3b7e386f`
response_id.title: Response id

phone.description: The phone number in E.164 or local format. The default country calling code is +1 (USA). Example `2069735100`
phone.title: Phone

name.description: Person or business name associated with the phone number. Optional. Example `Waidong Syrws`
name.title: Name

phone_status.description: Live-call status for the phone number: `Connected` or `Disconnected` (case-insensitive). Optional. Any other value is rejected with `status: failed`.
phone_status.title: Phone status

phone_right_party_contact.description: True if the call confirmed the number belongs to the right party. Optional. Any value other than true or false is rejected with `status: failed`.
phone_right_party_contact.title: Phone right party contact
